steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: The name's Veos. I'm a treasure hunter from the wonderous Kingdom of Great Kourend.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Across the sea to the far west. It is a truly magnificent place.

steps.player: Interesting. So what brings you to Lumbridge?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: I'm here on a bit of a hunt. The hunt for treasure. Back in my home of Great Kourend, I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Alas, I've hit a bit of a blocker. The scroll has led me here but as I don't really know the area, I'm not sure what to do next.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Hmmm. Maybe you can. You probably know this area better than I do. You might be able to work the scroll out. I'll be able to reward you if you help.

options.text: Sounds good, what should I do?

steps.player: Sounds good, what should I do?

steps.text: If the player does not have any free inventory space:
If the player has a free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Take this scroll. It should lead you to the treasure I seek. Once you've found it, meet me at my ship. It's docked at the northernmost pier in Port Sarim.
Treasure scroll

steps.player: Awesome. Anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: You'll probably want a spade, I find they're pretty much always needed when it comes to hunting treasure. Check the general store if you don't have one. If you need any extra help, just let me know.

steps.speaker: Veos
steps.text: Good luck.
